figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Tagpyrrollin A (1) directly targets AKR1B1. (A) Inhibitory rate curve of AKR1B1 treated with 1 for 10 min. (B) SPR analysis of
interactions between 1 and AKR1B1. (C) CETSA analysis of intracellular binding between 1 and AKR1B1 at 49, 53, 57, and 61 °C. Supporting
Information Figure S8A displays the image that corresponds to the uncropped version. (D) Quantified AKR1B1 protein levels (n = 3 biologically
independent samples). (E) Circular dichroism curves of AKR1B1 from 180 to 260 nm at a temperature gradient ranging from 20 to 90 °C with 5
°C increments. (F) Circular dichroism curves of AKR1B1 and 1 under the same experimental parameters as panel E. (G) Concentration profiles of
two AKR1B1 species in thermal denaturation assays with or without 1. (H) Tagpyrrollin A (1) comes with inherent blue fluorescence (405 nm)
and without other fluorescence at 488 and 561 nm. (I) Immunofluorescence analysis of compound 1 in HepG2 cells. The scale bars represent 50
μm in these immunofluorescence images of HepG2 cells labeled with compound 1 (50 μM, blue).
